notes: Ask the assessor for the current form for land, buildings, or machinery. Provide the supporting ownership and property records applicable to your transaction.
A tax declaration is not a land title and is not conclusive proof of legal ownership.

services: Transportation: shuttle bus and light vehicle
notes: Vehicle availability, approval, and any charges must be confirmed with the office.
Public procurement follows RA 12009 and applicable transition rules. Supplier instructions must follow the current procurement notice.

services: Change of business name, ownership, or location
checklist: New business: the Charter lists the applicable DTI/SEC/CDA registration, lease if rented, occupancy permit, FSIC, and applicable sanitary permit. Barangay clearance and community/corporate tax certificates are integrated into the BPLO system. Additional sector-specific requirements may apply.
Renewal: provide the sworn gross-sales/receipts declaration, financial statement, or income-tax return, and applicable sector-specific documents. Use the full checklist on printed page 308.
Retirement: the Charter lists the retirement application, business permit if available, and barangay certification that operations have ceased. Inspection and tax assessment are part of the process.
notes: January 20 is the ordinary annual renewal reference; extensions are year-specific. The published 2026 resolution extended processing to January 31, 2026. That deadline is past and must not be reused for a later year.
Ask BPLO to assess the fees and release schedule for the actual transaction.

tricycle-franchising.office: Business Permit and Licensing Office / Sangguniang Panlungsod
checklist: The MTOP checklist lists a community tax certificate, LTO official receipt and certificate of registration, city treasury parking-fee clearance, CTTMO/CPSO certification, PNP inspection report, and approved Sangguniang Panlungsod franchise.
notes: MTOP is the term used in Bayawan’s ordinance and Citizen’s Charter. The approved franchise and operating permit are related but distinct requirements.
Use the official checklist and fee assessment..

seedo-public-market.office: City Treasury / Public Market and Economic Enterprise offices
services: Market and slaughterhouse fees and charges
notes: Ask the public-market office for the current stall, vending, clearance, and entrance-fee requirements. Rates depend on the transaction and applicable city schedule.
For a complaint, report the incident and location to the market administration. Ask the office about the response process and expected timing.

seedo-slaughterhouse.office: City Treasury / Slaughterhouse and City Veterinary offices
services: Market and slaughterhouse fees and charges
notes: Confirm the animal-specific inspection, ownership, transport, and slaughter requirements with the slaughterhouse and City Veterinary Office before transporting animals.
Request the current assessed fees and operating schedule.

services: Employment, travel, service-record, and LGU-clearance certifications
notes: These services concern LGU personnel or applicants for government employment. Use the checklist for your specific transaction and consult HRMO about leave entitlements and current forms.
Ask the City Treasurer for the assessment applicable to your property or business. Discounts and penalties follow the current local revenue code and dated notices.
The 2025 amnesty catalogue contains conflicting end dates. That historical period has passed; ask the City Treasurer whether any later amnesty applies.

city-engineering.office: City Engineering Office / Office of the Building Official
notes: Building and occupancy permits are handled by the Office of the Building Official. The City Engineering Office and OBO have distinct functions.
checklist: The building-permit checklist includes five completed application copies and five sets of applicable design documents.
Provide the locational-clearance application, applicable title/land-right documents, detailed estimates, and soil test when required.
The occupancy-permit checklist includes the application, notarized completion certificate, as-built changes, construction logbooks, and applicable agency certifications.

services: Locational clearance for buildings, electrical works, fencing, and new businesses

notes: Program eligibility, available inputs, equipment schedules, and rates depend on the specific service. Ask the office which current program and checklist apply.
A tax declaration records property for taxation; it is not conclusive proof of ownership.
Obtain the current assessment and documentary checklist for the specific transaction. Transfer tax and registration of ownership are separate matters.

cswdo-services.office: City Social Welfare and Development Office
checklist: PWD ID: two 1×1 photographs, one whole-body photograph, valid ID, and medical certificate from the City Health Office, as listed in the 2025 local Charter.
Senior Citizen ID: two 1×1 photographs and valid ID, birth certificate, or voter’s certification, as listed in the 2025 local Charter.
For both IDs, the Charter lists no fee, 30 minutes for forms, and seven working days for the required signatures. This separates desk handling from the release process.
notes: PWD-ID rules: the 2021 NCDA order specifies five-year validity. The September 2026 unified-ID policy introduces lifetime validity for permanent disabilities and a phased rollout. Ask CSWDO/PDAO how existing and new cards are handled locally.
Senior-citizen and PWD discounts apply to covered goods and services under the relevant law. They are not a blanket discount on every purchase, and no general minimum purchase is stated here.
Financial assistance depends on assessment, program rules, and available funds; amounts and approval are not guaranteed.
